arms.label: Explicit native session resume for follow-up turns

caveats.message: The baseline arm reconstructs the conversation in the prompt; the native arm sends only the delta. The difference in prompt tokens is the thing being measured, so a cost win here is expected rather than surprising.

notes: Report 4B. Only multi-turn tasks (long_context) exercise the difference; on single-turn tasks the arms are identical by construction, which the report's per-task table shows.
